title: Inclusive healthcare
content:
I’m a transgender individual, I’ve been working with my GP over the past 6 months to help progress my transition. The GP has been very accommodating of my needs and has treated me with dignity and respect throughout. 
I feel very privileged to have had such a great experience during this time when many others do not. 
My sincere thanks to all that have helped me and continue to help me at the practice.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
